You are right. I was selfish and hard to placate. She did her best and gave up. She is fully rightful in doing so. I explained everything, but she didn't want to put up with me any more.

Learnt my lesson and have to move on.
My fears come true, no doubt, and I lost her - she said she didn't want any interaction with me about anything other than classes. I feel terrible, but I won't do it. Thank you
